description: This file implements polyfills and management for custom elements, mutation observers, and related web component features, primarily for supporting older browsers and enabling custom element registration and upgrade.

classes.name: WeakMap
classes.description: Polyfill for WeakMap if not natively supported, providing set, get, delete, and has methods.

classes.name: JsMutationObserver
classes.description: A polyfill for MutationObserver, providing observe, disconnect, and takeRecords methods.

classes.name: Registration
classes.description: Handles registration of mutation observers for nodes.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades a node to a custom element if applicable.

methods.name: upgradeWithDefinition
methods.description: Upgrades a node with a specific custom element definition.

methods.name: implementPrototype
methods.description: Mixes in prototype properties into an element.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new custom element with a given name and options.

methods.name: upgradeDocumentTree
methods.description: Upgrades all elements in a document tree.

methods.name: upgradeAll
methods.description: Upgrades all elements in a document.
